title: Slow Patch Adoption Risk Anza Report 2026
text:
Slow Patch Adoption Vulnerability - Anza Report 2026

Risk description:
- Solana validators adopt security patches slowly
- Window between patch release and full adoption exploitable
- Validators running old versions remain vulnerable
- Coordinated attacks possible during patch rollout period

Statistics:
- Average time for 80% validator adoption: 2-4 weeks
- Some validators run versions 6+ months behind
- Critical CVE patches take 1-2 weeks for majority adoption
- Superminority validators sometimes slow to update

Known incidents:
- CVE-2024-54134: validators slow to patch supply chain vuln
- Multiple RPC exploits during partial patch adoption windows
- Fee market bypass during version fragmentation periods

Attack window:
- Attacker identifies unpatched validators (version visible in gossip)
- Targets unpatched validators with specific exploit
- Exits before patched majority can respond

Mitigations:
- Automated update mechanisms
- Stake-weighted patch adoption incentives
- Critical CVE fast-track process
- Version gating for consensus participation
- Validator operator SLA requirements
Source: Anza Report 2026
